arguments.command:
set -eu
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('index.html')
text = path.read_text()
old = 'href="singup.html"'
new = 'href="signup.html"'
if text.count(old) != 1:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one {old!r}; found {text.count(old)}')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
printf '%s\n' '--- corrected link ---'
grep -n 'href="signup\.html"' index.html
if grep -q 'singup\.html' index.html; then
  echo 'misspelled link remains' >&2
  exit 1
fi
[ -f signup.html ]
./publish-site.sh
printf '%s\n' '--- latest deployment record ---'
tail -n 1 .effects.log
